action: Customers who reuse a Hugendubel password elsewhere should change it, enable two-factor authentication, check account statements and be wary of phishing emails posing as Hugendubel (netzwelt's advice).
date_note: netzwelt says the attack happened in the night to 19 November; its article is dated 21 November.
exec: A bookseller's online shop and its Tolino cloud were offline after a reported cyberattack; per Caschys Blog no restoration schedule has been given.
plain: German bookseller Hugendubel's online shop and Tolino Cloud were unreachable after a reported cyberattack. Per Caschys Blog, Hugendubel says no sensitive customer data is affected as of now.

sources.name: Caschys Blog (stadt-bremerhaven.de): Hugendubel: Cyberangriff legt Online-Shop und tolino-Downloads lahm

summary: According to netzwelt and Caschys Blog, Hugendubel was hit by a cyberattack in the night to 19 November; the shop notice cites a technical fault, per netzwelt. The online shop, Service Center and Tolino Cloud were offline, affecting e-reader downloads. Per Caschys Blog, Hugendubel says no sensitive or personal customer data is affected as of now and gives no schedule; netzwelt says it could take several days.
title: Hugendubel online shop and Tolino Cloud offline after reported cyberattack

validation.note: Two publishers (netzwelt, Caschys Blog, both 21 Nov) state the attack in the night to 19 Nov; Hugendubel statements are relayed, not read directly (Caschys Blog cites no original statement or link).

review.note: Compared with netzwelt and Caschys Blog: date, attack, no-sensitive-data statement match. Summary said Hugendubel gave no restoration schedule; netzwelt says it could take several days, so both now stated with attribution.
